articles.summary: Databases were built for applications. Deeplake is built for agents. A sandboxed, serverless Postgres instance that spins up with every agent, scales with the swarm, and dies when the job is done.
articles.title: Your Agents Are Drowning in Quicksand. Give Their Data a Sandbox.

articles.summary: We built a serverless, PostgreSQL-compatible database. Not a modified PostgreSQL deployment. PostgreSQL provides the interface. Deeplake provides the storage engine. DuckDB provides the query execution.
articles.title: Spin up Postgres in a second: How We Built Serverless PG for Agents.
